name: Financial Instrument Reporting Non Equity Transparency Data Report V 03
definition: The FinancialInstrumentReportingNonEquityTransparencyDataReport message is sent by the trading venue to the national competent authority to submit non equity specific details as part of classifying and applying necessary transparency non equity computations.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to the global report.

NonEquityTransparencyData.name: Non Equity Transparency Data
NonEquityTransparencyData.definition: Details the non-equity transparency qualitative data reported by a trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
